categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches `src/validation.cpp`, but only modifies chainstate disk flush error handling, which does not affect mempool acceptance, eviction, or policy.
categories.rationale: This change only alters block and undo file flush handling during chainstate flushing and does not touch mempool or transaction policy.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies `Chainstate::FlushStateToDisk()` in `src/validation.cpp` to correctly handle block-file flush failures.
categories.rationale: Failing to abort on block-file flush errors permits coins database records and flush markers to advance beyond data durably written to disk. As noted in the problem description, `FlushStateToDisk()` previously logged a warning and continued executing, which mzumsande pointed out can lead to permanent corruption if `-blocksdir` fsync fails.
